title: ‘Major U.S. Escalation’ Against Iran Soon, Experts Tell Zeteo
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
The commonly used definition of insanity -- doing the same thing repeatedly
and expecting different results -- is well suited to President Trump's latest
moves in the Middle East. Whether it be
[declaring](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116913091653271692)
the United States "THE GUARDIAN OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT," with a[ 20% toll on
cargo passing through the
Hormuz,](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/13/trump-says-us-will-become-
guardian-of-strait-of-hormuz-and-collect-tolls) or bombing Iran again this
past [Saturday](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/07/11/world/live-news/iran-war-
trump) and [Sunday](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/07/12/world/live-news/iran-
war-trump), the playbook hasn't changed even as the results stay the same.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, by the way, mocked the toll demand,
[tweeting](https://x.com/araghchi/status/2076728062662557961) sarcastically
that Trump was "absolutely right" before reiterating that 20% was "of course
too much" and that Iran "will be fair."

To try and piece together where things go from here, not just in Iran but the
wider region that has experienced the fallout from this illegal war, **Zeteo**
brought together **Mehdi** and three Middle experts for an insightful live
**Town Hall Q &A** Monday evening:

  * **Trita Parsi** , executive vice president at Quincy Institute and author of several books on Iran

  * **Rula Jebreal** , a Palestinian-Italian journalist, analyst, and academic

  * **Rami Khouri** , longtime Lebanon-based journalist and former policy fellow at American University of Beirut

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Together, they break down not only the immediate flashpoint at the Strait of
Hormuz but also the deeper, decades-long story playing out across Iran,
Lebanon, Gaza, and Israel. Was the resurgence of violence inevitable, or is
President Trump simply escalating to de-escalate? Is anyone prepared for what
comes next? And how is Israel calculating all of its moves? The panelists also
discussed:

  * A "**major escalation from the U.S. side in the next coming days** ", according to Parsi. "**I think it 's going to be quite terrible**."

  * Jebreal's take on the _[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/us/politics/israel-mahmoud-ahmadinejad-iran.html)_[ investigation](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/13/us/politics/israel-mahmoud-ahmadinejad-iran.html) into Israeli intelligence's alleged years-long effort to cultivate former Iranian president and infamous Holocaust denier Mahmoud Ahmadinejad as an asset and future Iranian leader.

  * The nature of the current and shaky peace deal between Lebanon and Israel that could collapse at any moment. "**It 's a neo-colonial affirmation of the fact that foreign countries, Israel and the U.S., will determine what happens in Lebanon**," according to Khouri.
